name: 按需图例
prompt:

Show the on-demand 怎么看 help opened as a mobile bottom sheet. The sheet temporarily replaces the normal node-selection bottom sheet, so controls don't stack into clutter. Dim the graph softly behind; retain context, no new full-page design. Clear title 怎么看关系网 and a prominent close X; a small drag handle. The sheet is not a permanent relationship explanation panel.
Include two compact accurate relation keys:

caption: 箭头指向后续概念，模型是大语言模型的先修。
相关: 大语言模型 — 预训练
caption: 两者相关，不表示先后顺序。
The related sample line has NO arrow; prerequisite sample arrow points RIGHT from 模型 to 大语言模型. No reverse or double arrows, no pedagogical mastery claims.
Then concise interaction hints in a calm readable layout:
拖动旋转
双指缩放
点击节点查看概念

The diagram behind remains schematic; do not invent more labeled nodes. This is the fifth visual state, not a real functional demonstration.
